text.title: RFC Template for Product Dev Team — Procedure
text.summary: Nine steps from a measured problem to an outcome-reviewed RFC: state the metric, current, target and date; list two or more options with rejection reasons; enumerate the blast radius with owners; name and test the rollback; date the milestones inside six weeks; name reviewers from the blast radius with a deadline; decide and set status; supersede rather than edit; re-measure the metric one cycle after ship.

step.name: state-the-problem-as-a-metric
step.input: The dashboard or query that shows the current state; the product goal that sets the target and date.
step.action: Fill `rfc` (`id`, `title`, `author`, `shared_on`) and the `problem` input: `metric` with its source, `current_value`, `target_value`, `by_date`, and a `statement` that names no solution. Add the dashboard URL to `evidence[]`.
step.decision-gate: A statement that names a technology ("migrate to", "adopt") or has no number is rewritten before anything else (r-problem-states-metric-and-target).

step.name: list-options-with-rejection-reasons
step.input: Candidate approaches, including "do nothing / keep current behaviour".
step.action: Fill `options` with at least two entries, at least one a real alternative implementation; mark exactly one `chosen: true` and give every other a `rejection_reason` tied to the metric, cost or risk.
step.decision-gate: One option means this is a ticket, not an RFC (r-two-options-with-rejection-reasons).

step.name: enumerate-blast-radius
step.input: The service map; the PR diff or design; traffic and tenant counts.
step.action: Fill `blast_radius.items[]` with every service, data store, API, scheduled job and user segment touched, each with its `owner` and a `count` for APIs and segments; set `schema_change`, `public_api_change`, `data_backfill`, `third_party_change`.
step.decision-gate: "Low" or "none" without the list is rejected (r-blast-radius-enumerated).

step.name: name-and-test-rollback
step.input: The deployment mechanism; a staging environment.
step.action: Fill `rollback.mechanism`, `execute_minutes`, `executor`; exercise the rollback in staging and record `staging_run.url` (or `exercised: false` with a reason); list every irreversible step in `points_of_no_return[]` with the check that runs immediately before it.
step.decision-gate: `data_backfill` or `schema_change` true with no point of no return is rejected (r-rollback-named-timed-and-tested).

step.name: date-milestones-inside-six-weeks
step.input: The chosen option broken into demonstrable increments.
step.action: Fill `milestones[]` with at least two dated increments a reviewer can click, query or observe; the last carries `ship: true`. Keep first-to-last within 42 days.
step.decision-gate: A span above 6 weeks splits into separately shippable RFCs; phase names ("design", "implementation") are rejected (r-scope-fits-one-cycle-with-milestones).

step.name: name-reviewers-with-deadline
step.action: Fill `reviewers[]` with every blast-radius owner plus anyone else who must read it, as `role:handle` with `commented: false`; set `comment_deadline` at least 3 working days after `shared_on`; set `status: proposed`. Share the RFC.
step.decision-gate: A channel, team alias or "everyone" is not a reviewer (r-reviewers-named-with-comment-deadline).

step.name: decide-and-set-status
step.action: Once every reviewer has commented or the deadline has passed, write `decision` as one sentence naming the chosen option, set `status` (`accepted` or `rejected`) and `decided_on`, and mark each reviewer's `commented`. Fill `templates/skeleton.md.j2`; run `scripts/validate-rfc-template-product-dev-team.py --file`; commit.
step.output: Committed RFC with status and decision.
step.decision-gate: `accepted` before comments or deadline is approval by silence (r-decision-has-status-and-supersession, fm-approval-by-silence).

step.name: supersede-not-edit
step.input: A later change to an accepted decision.
step.action: Write a new RFC; set the old one to `status: superseded` with `supersession.superseded_by`, set the new one's `supersession.supersedes`, and link both in `evidence[]`. Never edit the accepted decision in place.
step.decision-gate: An accepted RFC whose `decision` text changes in place is rejected (r-decision-has-status-and-supersession).

step.name: outcome-review-remeasures-metric
step.input: The metric source from step 1; the ship milestone date.
step.action: Set `review.next_review_at` no later than 42 days after the ship milestone. At the review, re-measure with the same method and fill `review.outcome`: `remeasured_value`, `same_method: true`, `result` (met | partially-met | not-met), `url`, `reviewed_on`.
step.decision-gate: An outcome that restates delivery ("shipped on time") without the metric fails (r-outcome-review-remeasures-problem-metric).

list.item: RFC validates via `scripts/validate-rfc-template-product-dev-team.py`, including the 42-day span, 3-working-day deadline, blast-radius owner coverage and accepted-only-after-comments checks.
`review.outcome` is filled with the re-measured metric within one cycle of ship, or `next_review_at` is still in the future.
